notes: Knowledge-injection SFT: the model learns this dataset and its knowledge base so it can answer without the documents in context. The experiment contract from the acoustic run applies: report the base model on the same held-out split, fairly prompted, AND a base-with-KB-in-context condition, because the honest question is whether the adapter internalised what retrieval would have supplied. Test questions are held-out paraphrases plus held-out facts never rendered as a training pair. Short examples (a few hundred tokens), so batch 4 x accum 4 = effective 16.
